promptText: Use case: stylized-concept. Create one original native 1254 x 1254 terrain patch precisely continuing the approved hand-painted fantasy game map. Image 1 is the exact local layout: repaint its existing shapes with crisp native detail; its blur is only a coordinate guide, never final pixels. Preserve the positions, surface transitions and edge geometry of both strips; do not stretch, resize or invent forms. Image 4 is the approved full map for art direction only, not objects to copy into this patch. Mostly open cyan/turquoise water. Only the TOPS of existing rounded coastal rocks enter through the BOTTOM edge: a very shallow peach-grey rounded cap cropped at bottom x=170..760, starting around y=1190; and a larger blue-grey/peach stone cropped bottom-right, whose rounded top starts around x=1110,y=930 and whose left side meets bottom near x=850. Preserve exact guide silhouettes and positions. Do not raise these rocks into mid-frame or create separate islands. Subtle white foam appears only where the guide shows water contact. Keep upper and middle water uninterrupted with delicate irregular native caustics. Refined rounded Q Daoist hand-painted game art, diffuse bright daylight, same elevated camera and object scale, restrained mineral detail and painterly surface depth. Keep the exact existing coast; no added rocks, architecture, vegetation, props, characters, text, interface, borders or grid markings. Native original detail, not an enlarged overview. Output the complete square terrain patch, no reference montage.
